about.heroSubtitle: HeicSave is a free browser-local image toolkit for iPhone photos and modern web formats — built for privacy, speed, and real-world sharing workflows.
about.principle1Body: Conversion runs in your browser with JavaScript and WebAssembly. Your photos are not uploaded to our servers for processing.
about.principle2Body: No signup, no watermark, and no paid tier for basic conversion. Open a tool and convert immediately.
about.principle3Body: Batch convert, ZIP download, JPEG/WebP quality sliders, and EXIF preservation on HEIC→JPG when your browser allows it.
about.toolsSubtitle: {count} free tools for HEIC, WebP, AVIF, and optimization — all run locally in your tab.
about.whyBody: Most "free converters" upload your photos to a server you do not control. We wanted the opposite: HEIC, WebP, and AVIF tools that decode on your device with WebAssembly and Canvas — private, fast, and free without an account.
about.operatorBody: HeicSave is operated independently at heicsave.com. Guides are written under the pen name Mira Vale. We are not affiliated with Apple, Google, Microsoft, or Adobe. Real people read privacy@heicsave.com and update guides when software changes.
about.whoWritesBody: Guides are written and maintained under the pen name Mira Vale. We publish original, device-tested workflows—not scraped manuals. There is no separate legal street address listed; contact us by email.
about.changelogIntro: We ship tool improvements and new guides regularly. Recent milestones:
about.changelog1: July 2026 — Author page (Mira Vale), restored guide illustrations, Contact topic helpers, home how-to / DevTools verify bands.
about.changelog2: June 2026 — Editorial standards on About; portal JPG compress and marketplace EXIF guides; utility tool comparison tables.
about.changelog3: May–June 2026 — Compress JPG presets, batch HEIC workflow, Premiere/Photoshop/Outlook guides; full German and French site translation.
about.editorialIntro: HeicSave publishes original guides and tool documentation—not generic SEO filler. Every article is tested on real devices before we link it from tool pages or the blog index.
about.editorialStandard1Body: Workflows are verified on physical Windows and Mac hardware with Chrome and Edge. We do not copy steps from forums without re-testing.
about.editorialStandard2Body: Long guides include batch sizes, file-size expectations, troubleshooting tables, and UI illustrations where they help—see our batch HEIC and portal upload guides.
about.editorialStandard3Body: When Apple, Microsoft, or Adobe changes behavior, we update the article and show a revised date at the top. Report errors via Contact—we read privacy@heicsave.com.
about.editorialStandard4Body: We do not republish third-party manuals, auto-translate competitor pages, or spin duplicate tool landing copy.
about.editorialTestingIntro: Typical environments for guide verification in 2026:
about.editorialEnv1Use: HEIC batch convert, compress-jpg portal limits, DevTools zero-upload checks
about.editorialEnv2Use: Fallback HEIC decode and strip-exif mixed batches
about.editorialEnv3Use: Transfer settings, HEIC→JPG handoff, marketplace EXIF scenarios
about.editorialReviewBody: Blog posts show a Mira Vale byline linking to the author page and these editorial standards. Major guide updates get a new “Last updated” line in the article and an entry in the site changelog above.
about.editorialFundingBody: HeicSave is funded by Google AdSense (with consent) and optional analytics. Ads and stats never receive your image bytes—conversion stays in your browser tab, separate from monetization.

converter.filesRejected: No matching images were added. On iPhone, pick photos from your library (not videos). HEIC, JPG, and PNG from the Photos app are supported.
converter.privacyVerifyStep1: Open DevTools (F12) → Network tab → enable Preserve log.
converter.privacyVerifyStep2: Convert a HEIC file. Filter by Fetch/XHR or search "upload".
converter.privacyVerifyStep3: You should see no requests carrying your image bytes—only page assets and analytics if you accepted cookies.
converter.privacyVerifyNote: Conversion uses libheif WASM and Canvas in your tab; HeicSave has no upload endpoint for images.

converter.exifHint: Copy date taken, camera model, and orientation into JPG. GPS is not copied. WebP/PNG ignore this setting.

errors.memory: {file} is too large for this browser tab. Close other tabs, convert fewer files at once, or use Chrome or Edge on a desktop PC.
errors.decodeAvif: {file} could not be decoded as AVIF. Use the latest Chrome or Edge on a desktop—Firefox and older Safari often fail.
errors.decodeWebp: {file} could not be decoded as WebP. Try Chrome or Edge, or re-export from your editor.
errors.decodeGeneric: {file} could not be loaded. The file may be corrupt or use an unsupported variant.
errors.heic: {file} could not be converted from HEIC. Use Chrome or Edge on a desktop, pick a still photo (.heic/.heif, not a Live Photo .mov), and try one file at a time.
errors.security: The browser blocked reading {file}. Reload the page and avoid cross-origin files.
errors.unsupported: Your browser does not support this conversion. Update the browser or switch to Chrome, Edge, or a recent Safari.
errors.generic: Could not convert {file}. Try Chrome or Edge on a desktop, use smaller files, or convert fewer images per batch. ({detail})

warnings.largeBatch: You selected {count} files. Large batches can be slow or fail on phones—try a desktop browser or smaller groups.
warnings.largeFileOne: "{name}" is over {mb} MB. Heavy files need more memory—desktop Chrome or Edge works best.
warnings.largeFileMany: {count} files are over {mb} MB each. Very large images may fail on mobile—use a desktop browser if you see errors.
